class.name: SettingsServerManager
class.brief_description: Registry of all [SettingsServer]s and entry point for starting them with the game.

method.name: apply_all
method.description: Calls [method SettingsServer.apply] on every server. Returns the last error of a server, or [constant OK].

method.name: get_domains
method.description: Returns the domain names of all registered servers, in the order of registration.

method.name: get_server
method.description: Returns the server of [param domain], or [code]null[/code] if there is none.

method.name: get_servers
method.description: Returns all registered servers, in the order of registration.

method.name: get_startup_phase
method.description: Returns the last [enum SettingsServer.ApplyPhase] that startup has reached, or [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_PHASE_NONE] if startup has not begun (for example in the editor).

method.name: get_storage_folder
method.description: Returns the folder of the settings files: [member ProjectSettings.settings/general/folder], by default [code]"user://settings"[/code].

method.name: get_storage_format
method.description: Returns the default text format of the settings files: [member ProjectSettings.settings/general/default_format]. A domain with [code]settings/<domain>/override_format[/code] uses its own [code]settings/<domain>/format[/code] instead. A format name written by hand into [code]project.godot[/code] (such as [code]"json"[/code]) is accepted too; unknown values give [constant ResourceTextSerializer.FORMAT_INI]. A domain uses INI instead if it can't use the format: [constant ResourceTextSerializer.FORMAT_CSV] is only for a [ListSettingsServer] whose list fits into CSV, and a format whose module is missing is not available (see [method ResourceTextSerializer.is_format_available]).

method.name: has_dirty_servers
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if any server has pending values that are not applied (see [method SettingsServer.is_dirty]).

method.name: has_server
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a server is registered for [param domain].

method.name: load_all
method.description: Calls [method SettingsServer.load] on every server. A missing file ([constant ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND]) is not an error here. Returns the last other error, or [constant OK]. The values are not applied; call [method apply_all].

method.name: register_server
method.description: Registers [param server] under its domain. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if [param server] is [code]null[/code] or has no domain, and [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] if the domain is taken by another server. Registering the same server twice does nothing. If the phase of the server has already passed, the server is started at once. Emits [signal server_registered]. [b]Note:[/b] The manager does not take ownership. Keep the server alive and free it yourself; a freed server is removed automatically.

method.name: save_all
method.description: Calls [method SettingsServer.save] on every server. Returns the last error, or [constant OK].

method.name: unregister_server
method.description: Removes the server of [param domain] from the registry and emits [signal server_unregistered]. The server is not freed. Reports an error if no server is registered for [param domain].

signal.name: server_registered
signal.description: Emitted when a server was registered.

signal.name: server_unregistered
signal.description: Emitted when a server was removed from the registry, by [method unregister_server] or because it was freed.

signal.name: startup_applied
signal.description: Emitted after the servers of a startup phase were started. [param phase] is a value of [enum SettingsServer.ApplyPhase]. Not emitted if [member ProjectSettings.settings/startup/apply_on_startup] is [code]false[/code].
